entries.title: Isaiah 57:1
segments: The righteous one perishes, and no one lays [it] to heart, and merciful men [are] taken away; no one cares that the righteous is taken away from the face of evil.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:2
segments: He shall enter into peace; they shall rest in their beds, each one walking [in] his uprightness.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:3
segments: But draw near here, sons of the sorceress, seed of the adulterer and the harlot.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:4
segments: Of whom are you making sport? Against whom do you make a wide mouth [and] draw out the tongue? [Are] you not children of transgression, a lying seed,

entries.title: Isaiah 57:5
segments: being inflamed with idols under every green tree, killing the little sons in the valleys under the clefts of the rocks?

entries.title: Isaiah 57:6
segments: Among the smooth [stones] of the stream is your portion; they, [even] they, [are] your lot; even to them you have poured a drink offering, you have offered a food offering. Should I be consoled over these?

entries.title: Isaiah 57:7
segments: On a lofty and high mountain you have set your bed; even there you went up to offer sacrifice.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:8
segments: Also behind the door and the post you have set up your image; for you uncovered [yourself] and went up from Me. You spread your bed and cut [a covenant] with them; you loved their bed where you looked.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:9
segments: And you went to the king with ointment, and increased your perfumes, and sent your messengers far off, and lowered [yourself even] to hell.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:10
segments: You are wearied in the length of your way; you did not say, Despair! You found life in your hand; so you were not weak.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:11
segments: And of whom have you been afraid or feared, that you have lied and have not remembered Me, nor laid [it] to your heart? Have I not been silent, even from forever, and you did not fear Me?

entries.title: Isaiah 57:12
segments: I will declare your righteousness, and your works; for they shall not do you any good.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:13
segments: When you cry, let your gathering deliver you; but the wind shall carry them all away. Vanity shall take [them]; but he who puts his trust in Me shall possess the land, and shall inherit My holy mountain.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:14
segments: And He shall say, Raise up! Raise up! Clear the way! Make the stumbling-block rise out of the way of My people.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:15
segments: For so says the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity; whose name [is] Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, even with the contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:16
segments: For I will not contend forever, nor will I be always angry; for the spirit should fail before Me, and the souls I have made.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:17
segments: For the iniquity of his covetousness I was angry and struck him; I hid Myself, and was angry, and he went on turning away in the way of his heart.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:18
segments: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will also lead him, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:19
segments: [I] create the fruit of the lips; peace, peace, to him far off, and to him near, says the LORD; and I will heal him.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:20
segments: But the wicked [are] like the troubled sea, which cannot rest, and its waters cast up mire and dirt.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:21
segments: [There is] no peace, says my God, to the wicked.
